mission: From the visible spawn, establish mouse-look handedness and camera-relative movement, traverse the visible trench and wall route using grounded movement and jump, then aim from visibly different positions to destroy and place terrain and judge whether each edit changes the intended visible geometry and later traversal.

controls.purpose: Capture the mouse for first-person look and gameplay input

controls.input: Move the mouse left, right, up, or down

controls.purpose: Move relative to the current view
Destroy the voxel under the crosshair
Place a grass voxel beside the face under the crosshair

notes: Judge only visible behavior reached through genuine mouse and keyboard input. Do not inspect DOM, application state, websocket data, source, or hidden readouts. A single still cannot prove motion, handedness, collision, targeting, or an edit transition. The HUD is ordinary product UI but its values are supporting context rather than substitutes for visible geometry. Classify uncertainty honestly and do not repair the product or harness.
